{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows where 'body_mass_g' is missing
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['body_mass_g'])

# Compute the mean body mass in grams
mean_body_mass = df_clean['body_mass_g'].mean()

# Also compute the number of penguins used
n_penguins = len(df_clean)

# Print both values
print(mean_body_mass)
print(n_penguins)"}
